name: manual_ef00a3
claim: Pin every third-party repository a script clones or updates to one reviewed commit id: clone with no checkout, check out the pin, never follow the upstream tip or fast-forward pull, take a deliberate override for a bump, and test it offline with a local fake upstream that has a newer commit.
conditions: pin third-party clone install commit sha supply-chain no-checkout

decisions.notes: 2026-11-26: an opt-in installer cloned a third-party repo unpinned and followed its tip; it now pins the upstream main commit of that day and five offline tests prove the clone lands on the pin, keeps it on re-runs and leaves no unpinned files if the pin is missing.

rationale: 2026-11-26: an opt-in installer cloned a third-party repo unpinned and followed its tip; it now pins the upstream main commit of that day and five offline tests prove the clone lands on the pin, keeps it on re-runs and leaves no unpinned files if the pin is missing.
